description: This Java class 'ShutdownReasonFactory' provides factory methods to create instances of 'ShutdownReason' based on JSON input or specific parameters, such as namespace or entity IDs. It includes methods for parsing JSON objects to determine the reason type and to generate reason instances for namespace purging or entity purging.

classes.name: ShutdownReasonFactory
classes.description: A factory for creating 'ShutdownReason' objects based on JSON input or specific parameters such as namespace or entity IDs.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ShutdownReason instance by parsing a JSON object, determining the reason type, and delegating to specific subclasses for purging namespace or entities. Returns a 'ShutdownNoReason' instance if no specific reason is matched.

methods.name: getReasonType
methods.description: Extracts the 'type' field from a JSON object and maps it to a ShutdownReasonType, handling unknown types.

methods.name: getPurgeNamespaceReason
methods.description: Returns a ShutdownReason instance indicating a namespace purge, given the namespace identifier.

methods.name: getPurgeEntitiesReason
methods.description: Returns a ShutdownReason instance indicating entity purging, given a list of EntityId objects.
